rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Superior Electoral Court diploma, dated Brasília 17 December 1994 and signed by Minister Carlos Velloso as President of the Court with the other ministers, the Procurador-Geral Eleitoral and the Director-General, certifies that by the will of the people expressed at the polls on 3 October 1994 Marco Antônio de Oliveira Maciel was elected Vice-President of the Republic, and qualifies him for investiture in the office before the National Congress on 1 January 1995.

locator.section: Whole diploma: "foi eleito Vice-Presidente da República"; "Brasília, aos 17 de dezembro de 1994"; "Ministro CARLOS VELLOSO Presidente"

bounded_scope: Vice-President observations for CLAUDE-C01-17 only (role br_vice_president of br_presidency). Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, same-session styling, the Vice-President's exercise of the Presidency, his succession to the Presidency, vacancy and any stated end stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Ministers and party offices are excluded; the office of President is CLAUDE-C01-10's br_president role.
